lines.text: It is over! {winner} has ended the run, and {loserClub} must finally look up from the chase!
The streak is broken! {winner} stops {loser} in full stride, and what a moment that is!
Somebody had to be the one, and this season it is {winner}! The run ends here!
The wall has cracked! {winnerClub} bring {loser}'s run to a halt.
Finally, a different name on top. {winner} has done it!
{winner} stood up to the run, and the run blinked first.
They said it could not be stopped, and {winnerClub} quietly stopped it.
End of the line for the run, and the one holding up the stop sign is {winner}!
The longest run in the room comes to a stop, and {winner} is the one who stopped it.
Turn the page, because a new chapter starts here: {winnerClub} have ended it.
After all that, a different name is on top. Season {season} belongs to {winner}.
You could hear the whole Showdown take a breath. {winner} has broken the spell!
The champion has been caught, and {winner} did the catching!
{loser} had a beautiful run going, but even the finest runs end, and {winner} is that ending.
At last! The streak is history, and {winnerClub} wrote the final line!
Down it comes, and {winner} is standing right where the run used to be!
Credit to {loser}, who made it look easy for so long. This season, though, it is {winner}.
That is the sound of a long run being unplugged, and the hand on the switch is {winnerClub}'s!
Nobody was meant to get through, and {winner} did it by {margin}.
{margin} clear, and the streak is gone. {winner} did exactly what had to be done.
It took a special season, and {winner} delivered one. The run is finished!
For a good while it looked unstoppable. {winnerClub} had other ideas.
How sweet that must taste, {winner}! You were the one who ended it.
Not this time, {loser}. {winnerClub} take the season, and the long run stops dead.
A new name in the winner's seat, and the old run is over. What a swing!
Change in the air! {winner} snaps the run, and the whole rivalry feels different.
They kept coming for this run, and finally {winnerClub} cut it down!
Hats off to {winner}. Others tried, and others fell short. Not this season.
The tide has turned, and it turned for {winnerClub}!
And just like that, the run is gone. {winner} has taken the season and the story with it.
Nobody saw the end of that run coming. {winner} did, and made it happen.
There it is, the one thing {loserClub} could not have wanted: a season for {winner}.
Hold on tight, because this changes everything. {winner} has stopped the run!
You do not end a run like that by luck. {winnerClub} earned it, every step.
Quiet confidence, and a loud result. {winner} brings the run to an end.
Imagine the relief at {winnerClub}. The run is over, and the winner is theirs!
The giant has been felled, and the name of the lumberjack is {winner}!
{loser} will tip a cap to this one. {winnerClub} did something special to end the run.
Wait, is that real? Yes! {winner} has finally stopped it!
It was a wonderful run while it lasted, and {winner} has brought it to a close.
Well played, {winner}. You have shown that this run can be stopped.
The seat on top has a new occupant, and {loser} must wait their turn.
For the first time in a long while, the name on the winner's line has changed: {winner}!
The chase is over, the run is ended, and {winnerClub} stand where they wanted to stand.
This is why they play every season. {winner} breaks the run, and the rivalry breathes again.
Make no mistake, that was a statement. {winnerClub} will not be anyone's passenger.
Take a second to enjoy it, {winner}. You have brought a long run to a full stop.
{winnerPoints} against {loserPoints}, and the run is ended. {winner} deserved every bit of it!
Run over, spell broken, and {winnerClub} are the ones smiling.
The champion's crown slips, and {winner} catches it before it hits the floor.
Sometimes a run only needs the right season to end it. {winner} found it!
Look at {loser}, who has not seen this look at the table for a long time. {winner} is on top.
What a response from {winnerClub}! The run stops, and the door swings open again.
Everyone talked about the run, and {winner} got on with ending it. Quietly. Brilliantly.
Forget what you thought you knew. This rivalry has a plot twist, and its name is {winner}.
It has been a long road for {loserClub}, but this season the road ends. {winner} has taken it.
The roll is over. {winner} stood in the doorway and would not let it through.
Breathe out, {winner}. The hard part is done, and it was the run itself you had to beat.
Not every story ends the way it began, and this one has just turned. {winnerClub} on top.
All good things end, they say, and {winner} made sure this one did.
Here is a run to beat, and {winnerClub} have beaten it!
Well, there is the crack in the armor! {winner} slips through and takes season {season}.
You could build a whole film around that season. {winner} ends the run, and the credits roll.
The grip has loosened, and {winnerClub} pulled the finger free!
It takes nerve to end a run like that. {winner} had all of it.
Run broken, and the rivalry is open once more. Do not look away now.
{loserClub} will want this one back, no doubt. For now, the season belongs to {winnerClub}.
Say it loudly: the streak is dead! {winner} gets the last word!
Rivals, take note. {winner} just showed that this run could be stopped.
There will be talk about this one for a long time, {winner}. You ended the run.
The pendulum swings, and {winnerClub} are riding it!
One season was enough for {winner} to change the shape of this rivalry, and put a full stop on the run.
Sometimes you win the season, and sometimes you win the story. {winner} did both here.
For so long it was one name, and now it is {winner}. The run is a memory.
And the long run comes to rest. {winnerClub} take the season, and the Showdown wakes up!
What a difference a season makes! {winner} is on top, and {loser} is the one watching.
Clean break, clear head, and a result that will be talked about. {winnerClub} end the run.
The shackles are off! {winner} has freed the Showdown from the long run.
That is what happens when somebody refuses to be next in line. {winner} ends it!
Shake the table, because the order has changed. {winner} is the new name on top.
It was not going to last forever, and {winner} made sure it did not.
The tide goes out on {loser}'s run, and {winnerClub} walk in with a smile.
A tough watch for {loserClub}, a joyful one for {winnerClub}. The run is over.
Never say never. {winner} proves the run can be beaten, and does it in style!
You can feel the weight lifting from {winnerClub}. The run has come to an end.
The big run has met its match, and the match is {winner}.
This is where the story pivots. {winnerClub} win the season, and the run stops short.
Too good for too long, perhaps, but not for {winner}! The streak is no more.
Down goes the streak, up goes {winner}, and the whole rivalry catches its breath.
Into the history books it goes: {winner} is the one who ended the run, and nobody can take that away.
A new hand on the wheel, and the old run is out of road. {winnerClub} are driving now!
It was always going to take one big season to stop it, and {winnerClub} delivered it.
Let the old run rest. {winner} has taken it apart, season {season} and all.
The spell is lifted, and {winnerClub} lift the season with it!
What a way to break a run: {winner} by {margin}, and not a hint of nerves.
Mark this one down, {loser}. Not a failure, just the end of a long, long chapter.
{winnerClub} did not wait for permission. They took the season, and the run ended with it!
Quietly, calmly, firmly: that is how {winner} closed the book on the run.
